title: TAPR：任务感知的提示重写器，提升LLM性能
summary: 提出TAPR模型，通过强化学习（GRPO）重写用户提示为任务优化提示，以提升下游LLM性能。在问答、摘要、算术推理等任务上取得一致提升，微调Phi-4-mini-instruct后，在Natural Questions和GSM8K上准确率更高。
summary_en: Introduces TAPR, a model that rewrites user prompts into task-optimized prompts via reinforcement learning (GRPO) to improve downstream LLM performance. Achieves consistent gains on QA, summarization, and arithmetic reasoning, with higher accuracy on Natural Questions and GSM8K after fine-tuning Phi-4-mini-instruct.
